question: Who is Mahomet explain
answer:
The commands and prohibitions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) are considered the commands and prohibitions of God Himself. [1]

Through the embodiment of prophethood (peace be upon him), God granted humans a source of knowledge. [2]

Sources
[1] Muqaddima Seerat ur Rasool 1 1 · PDF page 201 — «معالے میں رسول اللد ننم کے اوامر ونواہی وراصسل خداہی کے اوامرونواہی کہلاتے ہیں۔»
[2] Muqaddima Seerat ur Rasool 1 1 · PDF page 234 — «سو پکر نبوت کے ذریے قدرت نے انسانوں کووہ سرچشہ علم عطا کر دیاء جوانہیں ان کے»

question: What does the book say about personal piety and worship of God?
answer:
Islam is personal piety and worship of God within a framework of revealed universal ethical principles. [1]

These revealed universal ethical principles are to be implemented in human life. [1]

Sources
[1] Muqaddima Seerat ur Rasool 1 1 · PDF page 51 — «Islam (is) personal piety and worship of God in a framework of revealed universal ethical principles which are to be implemented in human life.»
